label: Interview Preparation
description: Prepare rigorous interview frameworks: background research, question sets for news, profile, and investigative interviews, and tactics for difficult or evasive subjects.

modelTier.notes: Haiku for basic interview prep. Opus for complex accountability interviews with legal sensitivity.

guidedInputs.label: Interview Subject
guidedInputs.description: Who are you interviewing? Their role, background, and connection to your story.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Dr. Maria Santos, Chief Medical Officer at National Health Service. Former pharmaceutical executive 2015-2020. Subject of investigation into hospital procurement.

guidedInputs.label: Story Context
guidedInputs.description: What is the story? What do you need from this interview?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Investigating whether NHS procurement decisions favoured her former employer. Need: explanation of decision-making process, response to documents showing she approved contracts, right of reply to allegations.

guidedInputs.label: Interview Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of interview is this?

guidedInputs.label: Documents / Facts to Put to Them
guidedInputs.description: What specific evidence, allegations, or facts do you need to get their response to?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Document A: email approving contract signed 3 days after joining NHS. Document B: contract value 40% above market rate. Public record: company paid her speaking fees 2021.
